integrity: An exact three-adic polynomial branch reduction proves the all-level residue multiplicity and least-period statements; an independent Python implementation exhaustively corroborates the first seven exponents. Finite checks are not an infinite proof.
limitations: The theorem concerns the binomial column of degree four at prime three only. Earlier general Dickson-polynomial over Galois-ring work was available at abstract level, so possible implicit priority remains unresolved. No independent validation is claimed.
title: Exact three-adic residue fibers of the pentatope numbers
